A new perspective on new staff 
Many employers are looking for new employees. At the same time, the Meedoen in Delft project connects employers with motivated newcomers who are eager to get to work. These candidates often possess work experience, skills, and a strong motivation to work and learn. Werkse!TheThe Municipality of Delft and the COA collaborate in this and support employers from recruitment and selection to work permit applications and on-the-job guidance. As an employer, you have a single point of contact, allowing you to act quickly and fill vacancies easily. 
Why working with asylum seekers works 
The labor market in and around Delft remains tight, while a group of motivated people is ready to work. Many employers wonder: are you allowed to hire asylum seekers? The answer is yes, provided you apply for a work permit. Many newcomers bring relevant experience and speak good English, while further developing their skills in the Dutch language and work culture. Werkse! supports employers with practical matters, such as the TWV: the work permit required to employ someone. For you as an employer, this means: 
motivated employees who are eager to get to work; - rapid deployability in practical roles; - strengthening your team. - At the same time, you give substance to social entrepreneurship and contribute to an inclusive labor market in Delft.

We specifically are seeking candidates showing great research potential with a track record of published papers or promising studies aimed at top journals. - Initiating, conducting, and supervising high-quality research - Publishing in top-tier marketing outlets and securing competitive external research funding - Teaching and course coordination in the BSc and MSc programs of the School of Business and Economics. - Contributing to the marketing department in providing executive education and collaborating with the business community and other stakeholders - Contributing to the Department / School through service and (eventually) committees - Be committed to obtaining a university teaching qualification, or possessing one already. 
 - Candidates are required to have a PhD in marketing, business administration, information systems, or a related discipline. - A track record of research publications in top journals in the field of quantitative or strategic marketing, or showing strong promise through high-quality working papers aimed at top journals - Experience in, and passion for, teaching in bachelor and master programs - Interest in collaboration with industry partners and societal impact; experience with executive teaching is a plus. - Fluent in English (command of Dutch language is a plus).
